title: Korean Practice Patterns for Screening PCA(Prostate Cancer)
brief_summary: This is to investigate Korean urologist's practice patterns for screening prostate cancer according to PSA level.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male with PSA more than 2.5ng/ml from 1 Jan 2008 to 31 Dec 2008

Exclusion Criteria:

* Age less than 40 at PSA screening
* History of drug use which can affect level of PSA within 6months before PSA screening
* Subject who participate any other clinical trial
study_population: Subjects with PSA more than 2.5ng/ml in 2008 from urology department of clinic and general hospital
